title: What lives on-chain and what lives off-chain
caption: The chain stores very little: a token, its URI, metadata bytes, and per feedback only value, decimals, two tags and a revoked flag. Endpoint, feedbackURI and feedbackHash are logged in events, not stored. The registration file, feedback files with proofOfPayment, and validation evidence live off-chain.
alt: Flowchart with three groups. On-chain storage: Identity Registry with agentId, owner, agentURI and metadata including agentWallet; Reputation Registry with value, valueDecimals, tag1, tag2 and isRevoked; Validation Registry, specified, with requestHash, validator, response and tag. Events only: NewFeedback carries endpoint, feedbackURI and feedbackHash, and ResponseAppended carries responseURI and responseHash. Off-chain: registration file with services, x402Support, active and registrations; feedback file with the MUST fields, mcp, a2a, oasf and proofOfPayment; response files; validation request and evidence files. Arrows show the agentURI pointing to the registration file, the registrations list pointing back to the agentId, NewFeedback pointing to the feedback file through feedbackURI and its hash, ResponseAppended pointing to the response files, and the validation URIs pointing to the evidence.
